data.action: 踮脚伸手取高处橱柜里的调料罐
data.description: 【洛琪希 · 居家厨房】飘满炖肉香气的温馨厨房里，系着淡蓝色围裙的洛琪希正踮起脚尖，拼命伸长手臂试图够到顶层橱柜里的调料罐。她有些窘迫地转过头——「唔……就差一点点！绝对不准笑我个子矮，快过来帮我拿一下啦！」
data.promptProse: Roxy Migurdia stands on tiptoe to reach a spice jar on the high kitchen shelf, turning back with a flustered request for help. A light-blue apron layers over her soft-blue casual dress. The medium view includes the extended arm, cupboard and simmering stew below, counter tiles continuing behind. Afternoon daylight brightens the raised fingers and jar, while pot steam catches the light above the counter's shaded lower edge.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 居家厨房
